train_references.name: Chennai - New Delhi Grand Trunk Express
conflict_citations: TAG 2026 Table Number Index (Railway Board) explicitly lists '12615/12616 Chennai Egmore New Delhi Grand Trunk 8'.
Southern Railway circular (June 2025) announced temporary terminal shift from Chennai Egmore (MS) to MGR Chennai Central (MAS) due to redevelopment.
Lok Sabha unstarred question answer (4 Feb 2026) references 'New Delhi - MGR Chennai Central Grand Trunk Express'.
Live CRIS NTES train enquiry system lists commercial operations between Chennai Central (MAS) and Delhi Sarai Rohilla (DEE).
train_references.note: Material source conflict across 4 official and operational systems. Quarantined in train_references; excluded from active trains collection.
